problemSigns.detail: Often the sound of a spring breaking under tension.

problemSigns.detail: A single broken spring means the opener struggles or fails to lift the door.

problemSigns.sign: Visible gap in the torsion spring above the door
problemSigns.detail: This clearly shows a broken torsion spring coil.

problemSigns.sign: Door lifts a few inches then stops
problemSigns.detail: Indicates a loss of spring tension, often due to a break.
When a spring breaks, tension releases, causing cables to go slack.
